scope: Line-level paragraph split around a topAndBottom y

implementation.split: Every rendered run carries data-run-index; measureInlineFloatSplits maps the float y to the natural flow slot of a paragraph, then findRunSplitAt returns {runIndex, offset} using element rects for atomic runs and per-character Range rects inside text runs
implementation.render: runs before the split, inline float block, then runs after; paragraph remains a single editable block
implementation.fallback: paragraphs containing images/text boxes/video/page breaks fall back to block-boundary exclusion

remaining: VBA macros cannot run in the browser (same as Word for the web)
